record_title: Atom-safe and tunable DKW bounds under approximate tensorization of entropy
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The bound uses ATE bounded differences and finite bracketing only; it does not recover the sharp finite-sample Massart constant in the i.i.d. case or establish optimal dependence on the ATE constant. The bracketing method itself is standard. Originality is to the best of our knowledge and is limited to the located ATE bracketing formulation, the removal of the continuous-average-CDF hypothesis in Roth's DKW theorem, and the retained/optimized bracket-resolution bound. Broad empirical-process and dependent-concentration literature remains a residual source of equivalent formulations.
